description: Real-time price updates every 5 seconds (batched) - lower bandwidth than ticker
send_interval: Every 5000 milliseconds (5 seconds) if data changed

unsubscribe_request.product_ids: optional - specific products to unsubscribe from

notes: Same format as ticker channel but with lower frequency (5-second batching) and without best bid/ask fields. Use for bandwidth-constrained scenarios.
use_case: Lower-frequency price tracking, reduced bandwidth requirements
differences_from_ticker: ticker_batch sends every 5 seconds instead of every trade, excludes best_bid/best_ask fields, reduced bandwidth
